decision: ACCEPT exact UI/template/builder/export source boundary; final actual desktop/phone visual review pending owner capture.
scope: Independent read-only source and built-byte custody; no owner build or browser suite rerun, no product source edit.

built_reconstruction.method: Independent Python strict-UTF8 read plus explicit known import/export removal and JSON-string embedding, without executing the builder

findings: Signed meaning is explicit in the exact-integral label, Q-I heading and negative-contribution prose. The graph includes y=0 even when all values have one sign. Amber shading is labelled illustrative signed contribution; it does not convert negatives to unsigned geometric area.

The midpoint graphic uses a constant sampled height per elementary interval; trapezoid connects neighboring endpoint samples; Simpson uses the correct three Lagrange basis weights on each two-interval panel. At normalized t=0,1/2,1 those bases select y0,y1,y2 respectively and sum to1. Floating geometry never feeds the exact model.

The curve is explicitly sampled and approximate, while every exact node, value, aggregate weight and contribution is taken from the frozen model report. The bounded polynomial and node count keep geometry finite and bounded; all model input intervals have positive width.

Lower/upper equality or reversal and invalid coefficients/mesh refuse through the previously received model after strict input parsing. Apply retires old accepted state before reading the entire form and remains retired on any read/model/render error.

Both input edits and select changes retire the accepted report, hide its result region and disable observation and inspection controls. Numeric blur change is intentionally not a second retirement after a successful Enter submit. Applying a preset fills the complete settings set then follows the same Apply path.

The inspection method lives outside the form and changes only the displayed method table/geometry. A valid observation download requires the retained branded immutable report and records the supported method separately. Serialization keeps all three rules and all five refinement levels.

Exactness text distinguishes the sufficient degree1/1/3 guarantee from accidental exactness outside that guarantee. Error-ratio wording distinguishes the first row, both-zero undefined, newly-zero undefined and finite ratios including0; no universal monotonicity or learning-outcome claim is introduced.

Course and guide downloads are independent of edited mathematical settings and preserve the original embedded UTF8 strings. They neither import a deck into the learner nor save answers. The explicit learner link remains a separate navigation to the existing demo.

The builder reads named local inputs, validates the deck with the existing validator and preserves its raw text instead of reserializing that deck. The known source import/export boundary is explicit; script-closing text is refused and embedded text escapes less-than signs. The final artifact independently reconstructs byte-for-byte from these exact sources.

Generated text enters textContent or JSON strings; the applied integer polynomial does not become executable markup. The standalone page has no automatic network, storage, provider or model operation. Blob URLs serve explicit local downloads and are retired after use.
limits: Actual desktop and phone appearance, browser event behavior and successful saved downloads belong to the owner browser gate until the final captures/receipt are inspected.
This source review is not a claim of cross-browser accessibility certification, universal integrand behavior or measured learning efficacy.
The builder is a normal regenerated-artifact writer. This review adds no crash-atomic write or concurrent-writer guarantee.
Historical source-reference access/licensing assertions are outside this bounded code/content review.
